text:
maya: Heads-up — planning a small config-only deploy in the midnight window. Targets: per-tenant rate limits, routing weight, and tiny batch window. No model changes.

jordan: Which routes? Do we pin any model versions or just routing weights?

maya: Only routing weights + batching params. No model pins. Canaries on 5% traffic for 30m. Change window 00:30-01:00 UTC. deploy-bot will run.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy 1734567890 by maya. Type: config-only. Canary: 5% for 30m. Rollback: auto on error >1% 5xx.

sam: Add a throttling tweak for tenant foo-legacy — observed KV cache pressure last week.

maya: Good call. I'll add a tenant exclude line.

maya: Config snippet:
```yaml
routing:
  default_weight: 1.0
  overrides:
    foo-legacy: 0.2
batching:
  max_batch_size: 8
  latency_target_ms: 60
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 120000
```

lee: Can we keep a static pin for critical-payment route? Want to pin to stable-model-v2 until tomorrow morning.

maya: yes — setting model pin for payment route only.

jordan: Observability checks?

ops: Preflight done: canary infra ok, metrics dashboards added: latency/payment-route, kvcache-evictions, 5xx-rate. Alert thresholds set.

sam: Rollback plan: manual rollback + deploy-bot auto-rollback on canary 5xx spike. I'll be on-call at deploy time.

maya: Thanks. Will kick off canary at 00:30 UTC. @jordan @sam @lee please be available for 00:30-01:15. :thumbsup:

jordan: 👍

lee: on it.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1734568200. 5% traffic -> 5m checks ongoing.

ops: Looks clean so far. no spike in 5xx, latency steady.

deploy-bot: Canary reached steady state at 1734568460. Promoting to 100% over 10m.

maya: Promoted. Monitoring.

sam: Saw a slight uptick in kvcache evictions for foo-legacy after the override — lowering its weight further to 0.1 as hotfix.

maya: applied hotfix, thanks.

jordan: All green from my side. closing out.

maya: Deploy complete. Notes: model pins applied only to payment route, foo-legacy weight trimmed, batch size reduced to 8. No rollback needed.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished at 1734568265. Status: success.
